name: West Build-Your-Own Utility Ramp Kit - 600-Lb. Capacity, 4ft.L, Model 1240
description: The West 4ft. Utility Ramp Kit is designed to load anything that rolls or has wheels, to a maximum lift of 12in.-24in. You supply the decking material 3/4in. plywood recommended, cut it to your desired width up to 48in.W, then attach the side guide rails that are supplied in the kit. The guide rails add strength and prevent you from rolling off the side of the ramp. Ideal for scooters, wheelchairs, strollers, walking, cargo and more. Includes two rubber-coated support fingers. Folding design allows for compact storage. Made of galvanized steel for strength and corrosion protection. Plywood not included.
